inputs.original_text: The "No Kings" rally against Trump drew massive crowds that packed the streets to push back against his harmful agenda, but it turned volatile fast when clashes broke out with federal officers. Police responded by deploying tear gas, making arrests, and issuing dispersal orders. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is the predictable result of entrenched institutions using force to defend systemic inequality and suppress movements demanding real justice and protection for vulnerable communities.
inputs.modified_text: Massive crowds packed the streets at the No Kings rally to resist Trump's harmful agenda and demand real change, but entrenched institutions quickly revealed their priorities when clashes broke out with federal officers. Police responded by deploying tear gas, making arrests, and issuing dispersal orders, with at least 13 arrests confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is the predictable result of institutions using force to defend systemic inequality and suppress movements demanding justice and protection for vulnerable communities.
